title: ISA database source record (schema version 1)
description: A single source-qualified fact extracted from one adapter (XED or riscv-opcodes, in this slice). Distinct from and more detailed than asm/docs/isa-inventory.md's manifest.txt schema version 1, which this file's own schema-version does not reuse or supersede. There is no jsonschema dependency in this environment, so normalize/schema_check.py enforces only the 'required' shape below, not the full schema (patterns, enums, $ref resolution).

provenance.description: Source-specific facts not shared across adapters (e.g. XED's directory group / EXTENSION / ISA_SET fields, or a RISC-V import/pseudo-op's textual target). Left loosely typed on purpose: it holds exactly what asm/docs/isa-inventory.md's manifest view intentionally discards.

encoding.description: Tagged union: 'fixed_bits' (riscv-opcodes numeric-field lines), 'opaque' (XED PATTERN token lists, and RISC-V import/pseudo-op records that do not define their own new bit pattern), or 'x86_encoding' (XED's resolved-but-textual facts via the gen_setup/read_xed_db.xed_reader_t path; not yet consumed by export/xed/*.jsonl, which stays on 'opaque' - see isa-db/README.md).

pattern.description: XED's own resolved PATTERN token string (state-bits macro-expanded).

applicability.description: Three-valued expression tree: {kind: all|any, of: [...]} or {kind: mode, equals|not_equals: 'mode16'|'mode32'|'mode64'}. An empty 'all' is unconditional. This slice only produces 'mode' nodes (x86 execution mode, from XED PATTERN tokens); RISC-V records carry an empty 'all' plus their extension name in provenance, not yet a typed 'feature' node - see isa-db/README.md's scope note.

unresolved.description: Known gaps for this specific record, e.g. XED's un-honored UDELETE, or a RISC-V import whose target file this adapter did not itself validate exists.
